item.title: VandenPlas shares pride in postpartum care bill’s passage
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A conversation about abortion among everyday people across the political spectrum helped give new life to a bill in Wisconsin.

item.title: Gibraltar alum Stillman enjoys golden experience at Olympics
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- When Jack Hughes scored on Canadian goaltender Jordan Binnington to win Team USA's first gold medal in men's ice hockey since the 1980 Miracle on Ice, it was the walk-off moment Gibraltar alum Brandon Stillman had hoped after rearranging his flight home.

item.title: Gustafson Announces Long-Awaited Purves Lagoon Road Repairs
item.description: Adam Collins -- Road reconstruction work is expected to begin later this spring in the Purves Lagoon neighborhood, bringing long-awaited improvements to aging streets affected by past high water levels.

item.title: Egg Harbor fire causes $100,000 in damage
item.description: Tim Kowols -- A fire in the fitness room of an Egg Harbor resort caused a multi-agency response and an estimated $100,000 in damage Tuesday morning.

item.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe statue tour to stop in Champion
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A connection between the continent's only Church-approved Marian apparitions will be formed next month when a life-sized Pilgrim Mother Statue of Our Lady of Guadalupe takes up residence at the National Shrine of Our Lady of Champion, located near the Brown-Kewaunee county line.

item.title: Middle School Mental Health a Growing Concern across Wisconsin
item.description: Adam Collins -- Middle school represents a critical period of transition for young people, both academically and personally, and Wisconsin mental health leaders say students are facing both difficult and new challenges.

item.title: Towns to meet about contribution to Algoma fire station
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The towns of Ahnapee, Lincoln and Pierce are inviting residents to weigh in on a proposal from the city of Algoma to contribute to the construction of its new fire station.

item.title: Southern Door seeking write-in candidates for school board election
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Southern Door School District is encouraging community members to consider running as write-in candidates in the upcoming school board election, as more seats are open than registered candidates.

item.title: Kewaunee County Food Pantry taps Weidner as new leader
item.description: By TIm Kowols -- A new face is helping guide neighbors in acquiring the necessities they need to put meals on the table.

item.title: Sister Bay seeks feedback on future administration building
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The future of the new Village of Sister Bay administration building is missing one thing: you.
